about_the_game:
ALERT - ALERT - ALERT

----------------------------------------------

Massive, unknown, hostile, fae-type entities are coming.

To defeat a "fairy", you have to learn the rune corresponding to its name.

To defeat a fae kaiju, you write the rune across entire city blocks.

----------------------------------------------

Sayonara Sigil Sentry is a short boss rush game merging bullet hell with "connect the dots". No longer will you be able to idle in a safe spot shooting the enemy. You will have to keep moving to draw the indicated rune, while your bizarre adversaries keep evolving with every completed rune.

Positioning and quick thinking will be integral to your survival.

----------------------------------------------

  • Face 10 bosses with unique patterns each.

  • Uncover a strange analog horror-inspired story about Celtic runes, poorly-interpreted Costa Rican folklore and the evils of big tech companies.

  • A haunting ambient soundtrack created by Unoperator.

  • Unlock alternative color palettes by playing previous ApeHardware games.

  • All for the price of 0€.
